jobs.title: Projektmanager / Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Werde Teil eines der spannendsten Start-ups Deutschlands. Wir entwickeln Künstliche Intelligenz, die als Zweitbetrachtung Radiologen auf schwierig zu erkennende Krankheiten aufmerksam macht. Gemeinsam können wir Menschenleben retten.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Als (Junior) Project Manager bei Floy bist du verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Implementierung unserer KI-Software in Radiologiepraxen. Du übernimmst die Betreuung unserer Kund:innen während des gesamten Prozesses – von der Analyse bestehender Abläufe bis hin zur Integration unserer Lösung in den Praxisalltag. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Kund:innen und interne Teams während der gesamten Projektphase. Mit deinem Fachwissen unterstützt du die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und bringst frische Ideen ein, um unseren Service zu optimieren.

WAS DU DAFÜR MITBRINGEN SOLLTEST

Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung, ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Gesundheitsmanagement, Gesundheitsökonomie oder verwandten Bereichen.
Erste Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement, in der Arbeit mit Kund:innen oder vergleichbaren Rollen.
Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, mit der du unsere Kund:innen begeistern und komplexe Inhalte verständlich erklären kannst.
Eine strukturierte und analytische Denkweise sowie die Fähigkeit, in intensiven Projektphasen den Überblick zu behalten.
Flexibilität, Eigeninitiative und Freude daran, in einem dynamischen und schnell wachsenden Umfeld zu arbeiten.
Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch.
Reisebereitschaft, Du bist 2-3 Tage unterwegs.

AUSSERDEM ARBEITEST DU GERNE
eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und organisiert
in einem Start-up setting mit vielen Entwicklungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten
flexibel: 100% remote, allein, im Team oder direkt beim Kunden vor Ort.

Wir suchen brillante, ehrgeizige Menschen, die danach streben, Experten in ihrem Bereich zu werden. Wenn du es liebst, immer neue Dinge zu lernen und in einer dynamischen Umgebung anzupacken, bist du bei Floy genau richtig.

WARUM WIR? 

Gestalte mit Floy die Zukunft einer präziseren und besseren Diagnostik in der Radiologie. Bei uns hast du die Chance, ein junges Startup aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen zu wachsen. Wir stellen dir alles zur Verfügung, was du für produktives und kreatives Arbeiten brauchst. Deine persönliche Entwicklung fördern wir durch schnelles Feedback, regelmäßige 1:1-Gespräche und spannende Herausforderungen.
Dabei profitierst du von maximaler Flexibilität, einer Remote-Teamkultur und der Möglichkeit, dich mit den innovativsten Köpfen unserer Zeit zu vernetzen. Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen oder eine Bahncard zur Verfügung.

ÜBER UNS

Schon heute helfen unsere KI-Produkte Radiologen, Krankheiten früh zu erkennen. Wir sehen eine Zukunft, in der Medizin und Technik Hand in Hand gehen und für die Patienten das beste Ergebnis erzielt werden kann. Nur so können Millionen von Krankheiten durch frühzeitige Erkennung bestmöglich behandelt werden.

Seit unserer Gründung im Juni 2021 haben wir über 12 Millionen Euro von führenden europäischen Investoren eingesammelt. Unser Team aus über 45 talentierten Menschen teilt die Leidenschaft für digitale Gesundheit und den Wunsch, gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden einen positiven Unterschied zu machen.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Das erwartet Dich

Bei uns bist Du aktiver Gestalter von echten Kundenerlebnissen. Du verbindest Produktwissen, Vertriebsstärke, Serviceorientierung und professionelle Kommunikation – und trägst damit direkt zum Erfolg unserer Kunden und unseres Unternehmens bei.
Dein neuer Job im Überblick:
Produktkompetenz: Du lernst in der Einarbeitung und darüber hinaus unsere Software und ihre Module so gut kennen, dass du Anforderungen sicher zuordnest, Nutzen argumentierst und Lösungen vermittelst.
Vertriebssinn: Du baust Vertrauen auf, präsentierst souverän und wandelst Features in echte Mehrwerte. Abschlussorientierung gehört genauso dazu wie Empathie. Wir leben das relational Sales Modell!
Service-Exzellenz: Du erkennst den Unterschied zwischen Wunsch und Bedarf, findest smarte Lösungen und eskalierst nur mit klaren Vorschlägen.
Kommunikation: Du beherrschst alle Kanäle – vom empathischen Telefonat bis zur formal korrekten B2B-Mail – und dokumentierst zuverlässig.

Das bringst Du mit Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium
Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Kundenservice, idealerweise im Software-Umfeld
IT-Affinität und Verständnis für Prozesse in Handel und Produktion
Kommunikationsstärke, Eigenverantwortung und Lust auf Weiterentwicklung

Das macht dich zur „10/10“
Du ordnest Kundenanforderungen souverän den passenden Features zu
Du nutzt Nutzenargumentation in allen vertrieblichen Situationen
Du findest für jedes Kundenanliegen eine Lösung, die für alle Seiten passt
Du kommunizierst verbindlich, wertschätzend und professionell – intern wie extern

Das bieten wir Dir Was dich bei uns erwartet: Mehr als ein Job.
Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer erfolgreichen Unternehmensgruppe
Bis zu 60 % Homeoffice – flexible, moderne remote Arbeitskultur
Großartige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und individuelle Förderung
Agile Zielplanung mit OKR – du weißt, worauf es ankommt
Offene Kommunikation & flache Hierarchien – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen
Raum für Ideen und echte Mitgestaltung – das ist uns richtig wichtig!
Ein Team, auf das du dich verlassen kannst – kollegial, motiviert und menschlich
Ein Mix aus jahrelanger Erfahrung und frischem Software-Mindset
JobRad, Workcafé mit Tischkicker, Ruheraum, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Events und vieles mehr

Über uns Willkommen bei microtech – dein nächster Karriereschritt!

Du willst mehr als nur einen Job? Du suchst eine Aufgabe, die dich fordert, inspiriert und dir Raum für deine Ideen gibt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir sind microtech – ein innovativer Hersteller flexibler Softwarelösungen und seit über 40 Jahren ein verlässlicher Partner für unsere Kunden. Mit ca. 100 motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten wir jeden Tag daran, noch besser zu werden.
Bei uns erwartet dich ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem deine Stimme zählt und du echten Impact hast. Wir bieten dir spannende Karrierechancen, die deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung vorantreiben.
Bereit, durchzustarten und die Zukunft der Softwarelösungen aktiv mitzugestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams – wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Senior CSM / Key Account Manager | ConTech SaaS | bis zu €90k OTE

Von €6 Mio. auf €12 Mio. ARR, jetzt auf dem Weg zu €24 Mio. und ein Customer-Success-Team, das 2026 konstant 148% seiner Ziele erreicht!!!

Für eines der am schnellsten wachsenden ConTech-SaaS-Unternehmen Europas suche ich aktuell erfahrene Senior Customer Success Manager und Key Account Manager für den deutschen Markt.

Das Unternehmen befindet sich auf einer echten Hockey-Stick-Wachstumskurve: Letztes Jahr ging es von €6 Mio. auf €12 Mio. ARR, dieses Jahr ist der Sprung auf €24 Mio. ARR geplant. Mit über 250.000 Unternehmen betreibt es zudem das größte Subunternehmer-Netzwerk im DACH-Raum.

Was die Rolle besonders spannend macht:

• Senior CSM: €75k OTE ODER
• Key Account Manager: €90k OTE
• Ungedeckelte Provision bei aktuell 120 bis 160 % durchschnittlicher Zielerreichung im CS-Team
• Verantwortung für 50 bis 80 Kunden mit ca. €700k bis €1.1 Mio. ARR
• Berlin (1-2 day office policy) oder vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands
• Klarer kommerzieller Fokus auf Retention, Expansion und Upselling
• Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Head of CS, CRO und Foundern

Gesucht werden erfahrene SaaS CSMs oder Account Manager, die bereits einen BoB von ca. 40 bis 80 Kunden eigenständig betreut haben.

Dabei geht es nicht um klassisches reaktives Customer Success Management. Du verantwortest deine Kunden von Kickoff und Onboarding über Adoption und QBRs bis hin zu Renewals und Upsells. Besonders entscheidend ist die Aktivierung innerhalb der ersten 90 Tage. Du musst Kunden proaktiv steuern, challengen und bei Bedarf auch pushen können.

Hier treffen bewiesener Product-Market-Fit, starkes Wachstum und ein sehr gut performendes CS-Team auf echten kommerziellen Gestaltungsspielraum.

Interesse oder jemanden im Netzwerk, für den das spannend sein könnte?
Jetzt bewerben!

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500 ™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

The Role

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Solutions Consultant
to bring our PreventionFirst Platform to electric utilities. This is not just another pre-sales role; it's an opportunity to become a trusted advisor to our most strategic prospects and customers, architecting solutions that directly address their toughest challenges. In this role, you will be at the forefront, translating complex business needs into powerful, actionable stories that demonstrate how AiDASH's PreventionFirst Platform secures tomorrow through climate resilience and operational excellence.

Our pending acquisition by Schneider Electric will accelerate our mission as we bring our combined offering to our joint customer base and deliver bigger customer outcomes than we could on our own.

Location:
Palo Alto, CA (hybrid/2 days per week in the office) OR USA, remote (near a major airport)

How you'll make an impact:

Discover and shape the story:
Engage deeply with prospects to understand their business goals and pain points, then craft and deliver a compelling narrative that shows exactly how AiDASH’s PreventionFirst Platform will solve their problems and deliver ROI
Win the technical sale:
This could involve anything from solutions architecture deep dives that map out how our platform would integrate with mission critical applications, to using low-code tools to create and deliver highly tailored demos
Create tailored impact:
Build and present customer-facing materials (slides, demos, business cases), that are deeply tailored and aligned with our product roadmap
Drive results across teams
: Rally cross-functional AiDASH teams to develop polished proposals that win new business
Be the expert:
Guide customers through technical questions and challenges, leveraging your deep knowledge of our platform and the competitive landscape
Shape the future:
Partner with Product team to ensure customer insights directly influence our roadmap
Stay ahead:
Continuously learn about industry trends and competitor offerings to keep AiDASH at the cutting edge

What we're looking for:

Competencies

Consultative approach to understanding customer’s business, goals, and challenges and how to partner with them to use our technology to achieve their business outcomes
Solutions-oriented problem solver who gravitates towards the “art of what is possible” even in ambiguous situations
Strong technical skills that allow you to configure tailored demos with low/no-code tools and have productive solution architecture discussions with clients
Exceptional storyteller who can craft and deliver a compelling narrative that resonates with both executives and frontline workers through live discussion, slides, and written documents and proposals
Strong, detail-oriented project management skills that enable you to lead cross-functional teams on key account initiatives and meticulously track details across a diverse project portfolio
Agility to thrive in a rapidly changing, fast-paced environment

Behaviors

High ownership and commitment to delivering high-quality work
First principles thinking that helps you arrive at the right answer in dynamic situations
Strong team player, comfortable working with cross-functional internal and external teams
Self-motivation that helps you persevere in the face of adversity
High level of curiosity that enables you to learn quickly
Coachabality and a drive to continuously uplevel your skills

Experience

8+ years of work experience, including in a technical domain
At least 2 years in a customer-facing role
Critical infrastructure industry experience preferred, but not required

What you'll love:

Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles
401(k) Plan: Begin contributing after two months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered
Parental Leave: Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
Generous Vacation Policy: Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you!
Winter Break: From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy time with family and friends!

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.

We offer a competitive annual pay range of $220,000 to $260,000 for this full-time position, which includes a base salary and bonus based on performance. This range reflects the anticipated annual pay range (base + bonus) for new hires. We strive to ensure our compensation packages are equitable and aligned with industry standards. Your recruiter can share more about compensation during the hiring process.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy-policy/

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

Are you motivated by building relationships, driving execution, and helping retail teams succeed in a fast-growing international company?

At IMBOX Protection, we are looking for a Customer Success Manager to lead customer engagement and field execution across North America. You will work closely with retail partners, store leadership, and internal stakeholders to ensure the successful adoption and growth of the IMBOX program across multiple retail banners.

What you will be doing

As Customer Success Manager, you will be the primary partner to Store Managers and District Managers across your territory, helping retailers maximize the value of the IMBOX program while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

In practice, you will:
Visit stores frequently (50-75% time on the road, with overnight stays required) to train staff, resolve issues, ensure alignment, and drive operational excellence
Act as the on-the-ground trainer and brand ambassador for IMBOX, coaching store teams on how to present, promote, and execute the IMBOX experience in the IMBOX brand voice.
Monitor store performance, track KPIs, and develop action plans to improve results
Maintain accurate CRM records, visit reports, and follow-up actions
Regularly communicate with the in-house service team to support high-level performance, issue resolution, and customer retention.
Support store-level campaigns, promotions, pilots, and new initiatives

Who you are

You are a self-motivated, hands-on professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You adapt quickly to change, work independently, and are comfortable representing IMBOX in the field while building strong relationships with store teams and customers.

We imagine that you:
Are a high school graduate with 1 to 2 years of college preferred; minimum 3 years of retail management experience required
Have a proven track record of building strong relationships and influencing stakeholders at multiple levels
Strong communication, interpersonal, and written skills required.
Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with Store Managers, District Managers, and internal stakeholders.
Have the ability to translate CRM insights and store-level performance data into actionable, revenue-driving strategies
Proven capability in identifying growth opportunities and driving customer loyalty.
Experience presenting to small and large groups of people, including internal and external collaborators.

KPI's & Objectives

Increase the average number of IMBOX treatments per store.
Increase conversion rates and average number of treatments.
Track performance against budget, prior year, and customer-specific goals.
Track number of training sessions completed, both in-store and virtual.
Maintain accurate CRM activity, store notes, contact records, and follow-up actions.
Strengthen Store Manager and District Manager engagement across assigned accounts.
Support and improve usage of the CSM Toolbox.
Support successful pilots and store-level rollouts.
Implement campaigns and contests, while tracking participation, results, and learnings.

Compensation & Benefits

Vacation Days: 20 vacation days annually, in addition to 11 U.S. federal holidays
401(k): 100% match up to 6% of salary
Health Insurance: 80% employer-paid / 20% employee contribution
Work Hours: Standard 40-hour work week (9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.) with flexible scheduling options
Equipment Provided: Laptop and mobile phone
Access to LifeTime Gym at Chicago River North

Practical information

Place of work:
Our office in Chicago, IL

Start date:
August 2026 or ASAP (flexible)

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About IMBOX

At Imbox Protection, you’re not just joining a company, you’re stepping into a fast-moving scale-up journey where ideas turn into action quickly and impact is visible from day one. We operate in a dynamic environment where growth is constant and change is expected.

IMBOX Protection is a global leader in automated protection solutions for footwear and apparel retail. Backed by a leading private equity fund, IMBOX is on an ambitious growth journey with a clear strategy and strong governance. We operate in 40+ markets globally and are expanding rapidly across key regions, including Asia.

We value curiosity, drive, and collaboration. In return, we offer an environment where learning happens fast, decisions are made close to the action, and your work has a clear and measurable impact. If you’re motivated by pace, purpose, and the chance to help shape a scaling business from within, this is the kind of place where you can make a real difference.

Sales and Customer Service

Manufacturing and Retail Apparel and Fashion

About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500 ™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

The Role

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Solutions Consultant
to bring our PreventionFirst Platform to electric utilities. This is not just another pre-sales role; it's an opportunity to become a trusted advisor to our most strategic prospects and customers, architecting solutions that directly address their toughest challenges. In this role, you will be at the forefront, translating complex business needs into powerful, actionable stories that demonstrate how AiDASH's PreventionFirst Platform secures tomorrow through climate resilience and operational excellence.

Our pending acquisition by Schneider Electric will accelerate our mission as we bring our combined offering to our joint customer base and deliver bigger customer outcomes than we could on our own.

Location:
Palo Alto, CA (hybrid/2 days per week in the office) OR USA, remote (near a major airport)

Win the technical sale:
This could involve anything from solutions architecture deep dives that map out how our platform would integrate with mission critical applications, to using low-code tools to create and deliver highly tailored demos

Drive results across teams
: Rally cross-functional AiDASH teams to develop polished proposals that win new business
Be the expert:
Guide customers through technical questions and challenges, leveraging your deep knowledge of our platform and the competitive landscape
Shape the future:
Partner with Product team to ensure customer insights directly influence our roadmap
Stay ahead:
Continuously learn about industry trends and competitor offerings to keep AiDASH at the cutting edge

Competencies

Consultative approach to understanding customer’s business, goals, and challenges and how to partner with them to use our technology to achieve their business outcomes
Solutions-oriented problem solver who gravitates towards the “art of what is possible” even in ambiguous situations
Strong technical skills that allow you to configure tailored demos with low/no-code tools and have productive solution architecture discussions with clients
Exceptional storyteller who can craft and deliver a compelling narrative that resonates with both executives and frontline workers through live discussion, slides, and written documents and proposals
Strong, detail-oriented project management skills that enable you to lead cross-functional teams on key account initiatives and meticulously track details across a diverse project portfolio
Agility to thrive in a rapidly changing, fast-paced environment

Behaviors

High ownership and commitment to delivering high-quality work
First principles thinking that helps you arrive at the right answer in dynamic situations
Strong team player, comfortable working with cross-functional internal and external teams
Self-motivation that helps you persevere in the face of adversity
High level of curiosity that enables you to learn quickly
Coachabality and a drive to continuously uplevel your skills

Experience

8+ years of work experience, including in a technical domain
At least 2 years in a customer-facing role
Critical infrastructure industry experience preferred, but not required

What you'll love:

Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles

new_jobs.description:
About the role

Are you motivated by building relationships, driving execution, and helping retail teams succeed in a fast-growing international company?

At IMBOX Protection, we are looking for a Customer Success Manager to lead customer engagement and field execution across North America. You will work closely with retail partners, store leadership, and internal stakeholders to ensure the successful adoption and growth of the IMBOX program across multiple retail banners.

What you will be doing

As Customer Success Manager, you will be the primary partner to Store Managers and District Managers across your territory, helping retailers maximize the value of the IMBOX program while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

In practice, you will:
Visit stores frequently (50-75% time on the road, with overnight stays required) to train staff, resolve issues, ensure alignment, and drive operational excellence
Act as the on-the-ground trainer and brand ambassador for IMBOX, coaching store teams on how to present, promote, and execute the IMBOX experience in the IMBOX brand voice.
Monitor store performance, track KPIs, and develop action plans to improve results
Maintain accurate CRM records, visit reports, and follow-up actions
Regularly communicate with the in-house service team to support high-level performance, issue resolution, and customer retention.
Support store-level campaigns, promotions, pilots, and new initiatives

Who you are

You are a self-motivated, hands-on professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You adapt quickly to change, work independently, and are comfortable representing IMBOX in the field while building strong relationships with store teams and customers.

We imagine that you:
Are a high school graduate with 1 to 2 years of college preferred; minimum 3 years of retail management experience required
Have a proven track record of building strong relationships and influencing stakeholders at multiple levels
Strong communication, interpersonal, and written skills required.
Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with Store Managers, District Managers, and internal stakeholders.
Have the ability to translate CRM insights and store-level performance data into actionable, revenue-driving strategies
Proven capability in identifying growth opportunities and driving customer loyalty.
Experience presenting to small and large groups of people, including internal and external collaborators.

KPI's & Objectives

Increase the average number of IMBOX treatments per store.
Increase conversion rates and average number of treatments.
Track performance against budget, prior year, and customer-specific goals.
Track number of training sessions completed, both in-store and virtual.
Maintain accurate CRM activity, store notes, contact records, and follow-up actions.
Strengthen Store Manager and District Manager engagement across assigned accounts.
Support and improve usage of the CSM Toolbox.
Support successful pilots and store-level rollouts.
Implement campaigns and contests, while tracking participation, results, and learnings.

Compensation & Benefits

Vacation Days: 20 vacation days annually, in addition to 11 U.S. federal holidays
401(k): 100% match up to 6% of salary
Health Insurance: 80% employer-paid / 20% employee contribution
Work Hours: Standard 40-hour work week (9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.) with flexible scheduling options
Equipment Provided: Laptop and mobile phone
Access to LifeTime Gym at Chicago River North

Practical information

Place of work:
Our office in Chicago, IL

Start date:
August 2026 or ASAP (flexible)

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About IMBOX

At Imbox Protection, you’re not just joining a company, you’re stepping into a fast-moving scale-up journey where ideas turn into action quickly and impact is visible from day one. We operate in a dynamic environment where growth is constant and change is expected.

IMBOX Protection is a global leader in automated protection solutions for footwear and apparel retail. Backed by a leading private equity fund, IMBOX is on an ambitious growth journey with a clear strategy and strong governance. We operate in 40+ markets globally and are expanding rapidly across key regions, including Asia.

We value curiosity, drive, and collaboration. In return, we offer an environment where learning happens fast, decisions are made close to the action, and your work has a clear and measurable impact. If you’re motivated by pace, purpose, and the chance to help shape a scaling business from within, this is the kind of place where you can make a real difference.
